contexts.text: See Thistle. AR 439:end.
Thorns (in the parable of the sower) = evils. (See AC 9144:8) ( = the concupiscences of evil. DLife 90.)
To reap thorns () = the evils and falsities which are of the love of self and of the world. AE 304:10. ( = the evils of falsity. AE 374:5.)
If fire catch in thorns () = (anger from evil affection) which injects itself into falsities. Explained.
That thorns = the falsities of concupiscences. Illustrated.
See Thistle. AE 391:28. DP 313:3.
A fire of thorns () = concupiscence of evil.
To gather grapes of thorns () = the goods of faith and charity from the falsities of concupiscences.

The falsities of concupiscences which are signified by thorns, are the falsities confirmatory of the things of the world and its pleasures; for these falsities more than all others catch fire and blaze up, because they are concupiscences in the body, which are felt; and therefore also they close the internal man, so that it savours nothing which is of the salvation of the soul and of eternal life.

The crown of thorns which was placed on the Lord's head, represented of what quality the Divine truth was then in the Jewish Church, namely, that it was suffocated by the falsities of concupiscences. TCR 130:3.
Hence it is evident what was signified by the thorny crown.
I descended by the ladder, and saw a level country covered with a dense growth with thorns and nettles intermingled.
By which both brains are continued into the spine...

When what is holy and good falls down from the Lord... into a man and the delight of his life, it is then as it were seed hidden in the ground. If the delight is pride, or the love of self, it falls into evil ground, where there are thorns; and so also if it falls... into the desire for gain.
To obstruct the way with thorns () = to obstruct all the thoughts by falsities of evil...
Thorns, and bramble-bush () = the evils opposed to these goods.
They do not admit any truth, and therefore are called stubborn and thorny ().
They shall be for thorns in your eyes () = that malignant falsities will inflict injury on the truths of the Church.
Thorns shall be in their tents () = the falsity of evil in worship.
For the tail is a continuation of the spine, which is protended from the brains...
The thorns shall come up in her palaces, the thistle and the brier in her fortresses ()... The falsities and evils in which they are, are signified by the thorns, the thistle, and the brier.
The thorn of the brier () = the falsity of evil.
That the evils of falsity will destroy all their good, is signified by the thorn shall be in their tabernacles ().
